Article.ArticleTitle: Clinical Trials Affected by Research Grant Terminations at the National Institutes of Health.

AffiliationInfo.Affiliation: Department of Surgery, Brigham and Women's Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts.
Department of Internal Medicine, Brigham and Women's Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts.
Department of Medicine, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston.
National Bureau of Economic Research, Cambridge, Massachusetts.

OtherAbstract.AbstractText: This cross-sectional study summarizes the number of trials with terminated grants from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and calculates the proportion of affected trials among those with previously active NIH funding, by trial status at time of grant termination and by trial characteristics.
